html.reason: HTML should update quickly after portfolio or generated page deployments.

css.reason: CSS files are static assets and can be aggressively cached when filenames are versioned or deployments invalidate edge cache.

javascript.reason: JavaScript files are static assets and should be cached aggressively behind versioned deploys.

components.reason: HTML partials are reused across the homepage and benefit from short edge caching.

feedsAndIndexes.reason: Search and feed files should refresh soon after CMS-driven generation.

images.reason: Static image assets should be immutable once published.

notes: GitHub Pages does not provide repository-level custom Cache-Control headers.
Use this policy for Cloudflare, a reverse proxy, or any future edge layer in front of GitHub Pages.
Do not apply immutable caching to unversioned HTML, sitemap, RSS, or search index files.
